quarterly_data.quarter: Legrand press release: Publication du premier semestre 2026 (07-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 results release: Legrand reports record sales growth of +17% excluding currency effects, with organic growth of +9,8% and +6,9% growth through acquisitions; adjusted operating margin after acquisitions 20,8%; net profit Group share +11,2%. CEO Benoit Coquart: the record growth was 'driven by data centers, offerings linked to the energy transition and acquisitions', achieved in a 'very fluid geopolitical and economic situation'.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 (French decimal commas as in source) sales +17% ex-FX (organic +9,8%, acquisitions +6,9%); adjusted operating margin 20,8%; net profit Group share +11,2%

quarterly_data.quarter: Legrand press release: Publication du premier semestre 2026 (07-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Full-year 2026 targets raised (the release states the raise without new figures). CEO Benoit Coquart: 'confident in our action plans, and given the performance achieved in the first half, we are raising our targets for 2026'. 7 acquisitions completed since the start of the year (one announced the same day), all in the energy and digital transition areas (data centers, energy transition, digital lifestyles), which already represented 53% of Group sales at end-2025; many new product launches under way.
quarterly_data.figure: 2026 targets raised; 7 acquisitions year to date; transition areas 53% of sales at end-2025
